notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. No deviation from the card's decision/helper: family-config with MujocoDriver serves the card's first MJCF model, learning/assets/panda_pick_place.xml (models[0]), as a simulated R0 world.sim; cap.world.step.v1 writes data.ctrl checked per actuator against the model's actuator_ctrlrange (eight general actuators: seven arm joints and one split-tendon gripper) and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults. The card's five entry symbols were verified in the clone: learning/robots/panda.py:82 FrankaPandaEnv, learning/robots/so_arm.py:29 SoArm100Env, panda_mujoco_gym/panda_mujoco_gym/envs/pick_and_place.py:7 FrankaPickAndPlaceEnv, push.py:7 FrankaPushEnv and slide.py:7 FrankaSlideEnv. They are Gymnasium environment classes; this package serves the card's model file directly, declares no native class, and does not serve those environments. MuJoCo was not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so the fake backend (fake.py) is a stand-in mujoco module: it parses the MJCF and its includes for the joint dimensions, actuator count and per-actuator ctrlranges, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint, applies no mesh, contact, equality or tendon model, uses the MuJoCo library default timestep as a marked placeholder because panda.xml:4 states no timestep, and resets to zeros rather than the home keyframe (panda.xml:280-281); it was never compared with the real engine. The sim path (a backend that backends does not name, which imports the real mujoco) was not run. Expected warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is a stand-in library module, not the upstream simulator, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface to check) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl and seed). No operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. The card's upstream license_spdx is NOASSERTION and the clone has no LICENSE file; the lock records that value and this package claims no licence. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
